title: Dead End City — military M4 Utility review
introduction: Native captures from the previous published build and this M4 update. Wheel and puncture comparisons use matched High-quality inspection views on clear airport pavement; the base comparison uses matched Low quality and normal gameplay zoom. All use seed 1, clear weather, 13:00 lighting and a 1000 × 700 viewport. The full audit retains inputs, source hashes, CPU measurements and their limits.

comparisons.title: M4 Utility — corrected intact tyre and rim shape
comparisons.description: The actual source tyre was about 1.2% narrower than tall. The corrected shared geometry keeps the intact tyre, rim and hub bands circular while rolling and steering.

comparisons.title: Punctured tyre — metal rim stays round
comparisons.description: Previously a puncture compressed the entire wheel, flattening its metal rim by 18%. The updated M4 deforms the rubber while the rim and bead remain rigid. These views use an actual collision-induced front-right puncture and rolling wheel, followed by a verified repair.

comparisons.title: Fort Sentinel — military M4 under fire
comparisons.description: The actual motor-pool M4 after theft, retaining the alarm and five-star response. The cached spatial lookup reduces the triangle searches needed for bullet-hole placement while keeping body and damage detail. Native images show the game; the audit records the separate performance measurements.

screenshots.title: M4 Utility — clear view at High quality
screenshots.description: A separate High-quality detail view shows the retained camouflage body and corrected wheels.
